title: Electrochemically enhanced oxygen evolution and urea oxidation reactions with advanced high-entropy LDH nanoneedles
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1829-1838
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00054H, Paper
Chandrasekaran Pitchai, Chih-Ming Chen
This study describes the synthesis of high-entropy layered double hydroxide (HE-LDH) nanoneedles, via a simple hydrothermal method using cost-effective non-noble transition metals (Fe, Co, Cr, Mn, and Zn), for efficient electrocatalysis.
